name: L.A.W Heavyweight Belt
epitaph: Billed in the fed's own founding handbook (11 August 1998) as "the most important [belt] in L.A.W," to be awarded by record and roleplay performance rather than an immediate tournament; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: L.A.W Western States Belt
epitaph: The fed's own secondary singles title, per the founding handbook (11 August 1998), representing "the Western state, including California"; no titleholder or title match survives in the record read for this pass.

name: L.A.W Universal Tag Team Belts
epitaph: The fed's own tag team title, per the founding handbook (11 August 1998), to be won by "the best recorded tag team in L.A.W"; no titleholders or title match survive in the record read for this pass.

name: L.A.W. Skyweight Championship
epitaph: A singles title the champion escaped defending rather than risk losing outright, provoking a rematch challenge that the surviving record does not resolve.
